name: Schedule_Holds
label: Schedule Holds
_about: Soft holds (spec v1.4, Delivery 01, 'Earliest available date'): a quoted date holds the capacity for soft_hold_minutes (default 20) so two sales agents cannot both promise the same last slot. Written by server/modules/delivery-management/earliest-slot.mjs only.

fields.helpText: True once converted into a real appointment or explicitly released; an expired-but-unreleased hold is just ignored by date math, never cleaned up by a job.
